scientific_integrity: Proof is an analytic bounded-martingale and strict Lyapunov argument. The rational checker only covers finite words. No claim of independent external verification or certification.
scientific_limitations: Independent fair whole-environment sign choices; all cyclic strengths in (0,1). The exact coexistence point is exceptional. Finite-population spatial and biased switching models are not covered. Novelty is relative to cited primary texts and indexed comparisons.
title: Isolated coexistence and exact fixation under fair reversal of cyclic Volterra competition
